title: Women As One RISE 2026 at ESC
summary: Photography and film at Women As One's RISE 2026 in Munich, alongside the ESC Congress: a headshot booth, street interviews, a walk-up Q&A and highlight films for social.
body:
RISE 2026 brought the Women As One community together in Munich on 27 August, alongside the ESC Congress. We covered the whole day in photography and film.

Two photographers worked in parallel: one roaming the sessions, speakers and networking, and one running a headshot booth with a portable white backdrop, studio lighting and retouching, open throughout the day and timed around the lunch symposia. A director-producer and cinematographer filmed the sessions and candid moments, recorded two to three woman-on-the-street interviews and ran a walk-up Q&A activation.

We delivered a full event gallery with social-ready crops, a retouched headshot gallery, a one to two minute highlight film and a 30-second social cut, the street interview films, a 9:16 Q&A video for social, and all the footage organised by type. Edited event photos can be turned around within 24 to 48 hours of the event.
